system.description:
You embody the shadows and fear, and the ability to compel at will.

When you roll initiative, you begin to radiate a small aura of shadows around yourself as the range of your blind sight from the Echolocation ability is increased to 40 feet.

Additionally, If you would ever teleport into a space that is dimly lit or in darkness that is adjacent to a creature that is Berserked, Charmed, Confused, Demoralized or Shaken, you can, as part of the same action used to teleport, force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, select one creature they can see that is in initiative. They must spend their movement, action and bonus action to harm the select creature. When they have dealt damage to the target creature 3 times, this effect ends on them. A creature that passes their save by 5 or more, becomes immune to this effect until you complete a rest.
